description.value: The Copper Pit is Princeton's only Southern Style BBQ restaurant, a family-owned establishment serving slow-smoked meats, craft burgers, and AAA beef steaks alongside a full bar with 12 draught beers including 11 local craft options. All food is made in-house from locally sourced ingredients, including wild Pacific salmon, with self-described generous portions. A private banquet room is available for group gatherings, and a mobile BBQ pit operates at local events during summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, full-service dine-in restaurant at 157 Vermilion Ave, Princeton, with phone 250-295-3305 and address matching OSM. The menu page explicitly labels the Artichoke Spinach Dip as 'Gluten free', supporting a true value for Vegetarian/vegan/GF. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or water refill, so those remain null. OSM opening hours differ from the website's 'New Summer Hours', flagged as a concern.
concerns: Website copyright reads '© 2018' and hours are labelled 'New Summer Hours' without a year — content may be outdated. OSM opening hours (Su-Th 11:00-22:00, Fr,Sa 11:00-23:00) differ from website hours (Mon-Sat 11am-8:30pm, Sun 8am-8:30pm); current hours should be verified before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fully operational dine-in restaurant with a substantial, calorie-dense menu in Princeton, a key community on Similkameen Valley cycling routes; hearty BBQ portions make it a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
